Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Convrs.

items.security_a: Yes, absolutely. All conversions you perform on Convrs happen 100% inside your browser (client-side). Your files never leave your device; they are never uploaded, saved, or shared with third parties. Video and audio tools use WebAssembly engines that also run entirely in your device's memory. That's why you always have full control over your personal photos, documents, or work files. For more details, check out our Privacy Policy.
items.paid_a: No, Convrs is completely free. There are no limits on the number of file conversions or usage duration. However, since all processing happens 100% in your browser (client-side), file size limits are in place to prevent your device's memory from overflowing and crashing (20 MB for images, 50 MB for documents, 100 MB for media).
items.formats_a: Convrs supports a very wide range of formats. Image tools cover HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, and ICO files; document and data tools handle PDF, DOCX, XLSX, JSON, XML, and Markdown conversions. Media tools process MP4, WebM, WAV, and MP3 formats, while developer tools include Base64, URL, QR, JWT, hash, and color code conversions. You can find all tools in the sidebar menu.
items.mobile_q: Do conversions work on mobile devices?
items.mobile_a: Yes. Convrs works seamlessly on all devices with a modern browser — phone, tablet, or desktop. All our conversion tools have responsive designs and are fully compatible with touch screens. No app installation required; you can select and convert your files directly from your browser. Since processing happens on your device, performance depends only on your device's processing power and browser version.

heic-to-jpg.title: HEIC → JPG

jpg-to-webp.title: JPG ↔ WebP
jpg-to-webp.description: Convert JPG files to Google's lightweight WebP format with WebAssembly.

png-to-jpg.title: PNG ↔ JPG
png-to-jpg.description: Two-way PNG/JPG conversion with HTML5 Canvas; transparency is flattened onto a white background.

svg-to-png.title: SVG ↔ PNG
svg-to-png.description: Rasterize vector SVG into transparent PNG, or embed PNG back into SVG.

webp-to-png.title: WebP ↔ PNG
webp-to-png.description: Convert lightweight WebP images into lossless PNG, preserving transparency.

ico-to-png.title: ICO ↔ PNG
ico-to-png.description: Convert ICO icons to transparent PNG, or generate an ICO icon from a PNG.

pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF ↔ Image
pdf-to-jpg.description: Extract PDF pages as JPG, or combine multiple images into a single PDF with pdf-lib.

json-to-csv.title: JSON ↔ CSV
json-to-csv.description: Turn JSON records into a table, and CSV tables into JSON. Pure JavaScript, zero requests.

xml-to-json.title: XML ↔ JSON
xml-to-json.description: Convert XML to JSON with DOMParser and JSON back to XML. Two-way and instant.

markdown-to-html.title: Markdown ↔ HTML

xlsx-to-csv.title: XLSX ↔ CSV

url-converter.title: URL Converter

qr-generator.title: QR Generator

pdf-merge-split.title: PDF Merge & Split

docx-to-pdf.title: DOCX ↔ PDF

image-compressor.title: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images with HTML5 Canvas, lowering quality and reducing size.

remove-background.title: Remove Background

video-to-mp3.title: Video to MP3

mp4-to-webm.title: MP4 ↔ WebM

wav-to-mp3.title: WAV ↔ MP3
